# ImgSplit — Complete Reference

> Free online image tools — split, grid, resize, compress, watermark, and more. 100% browser-based image processing; your images never leave your device.

## What is ImgSplit?

ImgSplit (imgsplit.com) is a free, open-source, privacy-first online image toolkit. All image processing runs locally in your browser using the HTML5 Canvas API — no uploads, no server-side image handling.

The core workflow is manual image splitting: drag horizontal and vertical split lines to divide images with pixel-perfect precision. Beyond splitting, ImgSplit offers grid layouts, carousel slides, resizing, compression, watermarks, privacy masking, collages, social media export, and local AI background removal.

No account is required, and the tool works on desktop and mobile browsers.

## Who Built ImgSplit?

ImgSplit was created by ZooHero, a full-stack developer focused on building free, privacy-first web tools.

- Website: https://imgsplit.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/ZooHero500/imgsplit
- Twitter: https://x.com/zooheroes

## Brand Notice

ImgSplit (imgsplit.com) is **not affiliated** with the npm package `@imgsplit/core`, github.com/imgsplit/imgsplit, or imgsplit.com.tr. The official source repository is https://github.com/ZooHero500/imgsplit.

## Core Features

- **Manual split lines**: Add up to 20 horizontal and 20 vertical split lines, drag them to exact positions
- **Snap alignment**: Lines snap to common positions for precise, even splits
- **Grid splitting**: Pre-configured grid layouts (3×3, 1×3, 2×2) for social media posts
- **Carousel splitting**: Split wide images into carousel slides for Instagram and social platforms
- **Image resize**: Resize, crop, rotate, and export to any dimension
- **Compress & convert**: Compress images and convert between PNG, JPEG, and WebP
- **Watermarks**: Add text or logo watermarks with opacity and placement control
- **Privacy mask**: Hide faces, license plates, addresses with mosaic, blur, or solid cover
- **Photo collage**: Combine multiple photos into grid, story, and mosaic layouts
- **Social export**: Turn one image into multiple platform-ready sizes, download as ZIP
- **Local AI background removal**: Runs in browser Web Worker; one-time model download, images never uploaded
- **Pixel-perfect precision**: Crops at original resolution with zero quality loss — no compression, no scaling
- **Multi-format support**: PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP, up to 20MB per file
- **One-click ZIP download**: Download all split pieces as a ZIP archive, or save individually
- **Live preview**: See split results in real-time as you adjust line positions
- **Cross-device**: Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers
- **Privacy-first**: All image processing in-browser; images never uploaded to any server

## Tools

### Image Splitter (Main Tool)
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/
- Full-featured image splitter with custom horizontal and vertical split lines
- Supports drag-and-drop upload, snap alignment, and batch processing
- Use for: general image splitting, custom crop regions, batch operations

### Grid Splitter
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/grid
- Split images into pre-configured grid tiles for social media
- Grid types: 3×3 (nine-grid for Instagram profiles), 1×3 (horizontal triptych), 2×2 (four-panel)
- Use for: Instagram grid posts, Facebook multi-image posts, social media profiles

### Carousel Splitter
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/carousel
- Split wide images into carousel slides for Instagram and social media
- Use for: panoramic images, wide banners, carousel posts

### Image Resizer
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/resize
- Resize, crop, rotate, and export images to any dimension
- Use for: resizing for web, social media, or print

### Image Compressor
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/compress
- Compress images and convert between PNG, JPEG, and WebP
- Use for: reducing file size, format conversion

### Watermark Tool
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/watermark
- Add text or logo watermarks with opacity and placement control
- Use for: branding, copyright protection

### Privacy Mask
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/mosaic
- Hide faces, license plates, addresses, and sensitive areas with mosaic, blur, or solid cover
- Use for: privacy protection in screenshots and photos

### Photo Collage
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/collage
- Combine multiple photos into grid, story, and mosaic layouts
- Use for: social media posts, photo albums

### Social Export
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/social-export
- Turn one image into multiple platform-ready sizes, download as named ZIP
- Use for: multi-platform social media publishing

### AI Background Remover
- URL: https://imgsplit.com/remove-background
- Remove image backgrounds locally with a browser Web Worker
- One-time model download; images never uploaded; transparent PNG export
- Use for: product photos, portraits, design assets

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What image formats does ImgSplit support?
ImgSplit supports PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP images, with a maximum file size of 20MB per image.

### Does splitting reduce image quality?
No. ImgSplit crops at the original resolution using the Canvas API — no compression, no scaling, no quality loss.

### Is my image data safe?
Yes. All image processing happens locally in your browser using the HTML5 Canvas API. No image data is ever uploaded to any server. We use anonymous product analytics (self-hosted Umami) and error monitoring (Sentry); no advertising cookies, no personal identity tracking.

### How many split lines can I add?
Up to 20 horizontal and 20 vertical split lines per image, allowing for very fine grid splits.

### Do I need to create an account?
No. No registration, no login required. Open the page and start using it — completely free.

### Does it work on mobile?
Yes. ImgSplit is fully responsive and works on phones, tablets, and desktop browsers.

### Is ImgSplit open source?
Yes. The full source code is available at https://github.com/ZooHero500/imgsplit under the MIT License.

## Technical Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 with App Router
- **Image Processing**: HTML5 Canvas API (client-side only)
- **AI Background Removal**: Browser Web Worker with @huggingface/transformers (local model, no upload)
- **Languages**: English, Chinese (zh-CN), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Spanish (es), Portuguese (pt-BR) — 6 languages
- **Analytics**: Self-hosted Umami (anonymous page views, no cookies)
- **Error Monitoring**: Sentry (anonymous error reports, no image data)
- **Hosting**: Vercel
- **License**: MIT (open source)

## Key Facts

- Price: Free (no signup required, no premium tiers)
- Privacy: All image processing in-browser — images never uploaded, no server-side image processing. Anonymous product analytics and error monitoring only.
- Limits: Up to 20 horizontal + 20 vertical split lines per image
- File size: Up to 20MB per image
- Formats: PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP
- Open source: https://github.com/ZooHero500/imgsplit
